ARIAConfig.title:
=============================================================================
 ARIA & ACCESSIBILITY CONFIGURATION PROTO
 =============================================================================
 Defines comprehensive accessibility configuration following WCAG 2.1 AA
 standards with ARIA (Accessible Rich Internet Applications) support.

 This schema enables:
 - WCAG 2.1 AA compliance
 - Screen reader optimization
 - Keyboard navigation enhancement
 - Focus management
 - Color contrast enforcement
 - Alternative text management
 - Semantic HTML structure
 - Assistive technology support

 Related Documentation:
 - Implementation Guide: ../ARIA-EXAMPLES.md
 - Mappings: aria-mappings.yml
 - Parent Schema: ecosystem.proto
 =============================================================================
